title: Managed native DTMF original/current audience through signal IO
scope: Isolated local macOS arm64 reusable-engine composition. Real signed EdDSA QUIC/WebTransport native source/recipient IO uses controlled current signal policy; Core private-audience cases are controlled scene callbacks. No production Connect DTMF dispatch or Store recipient effects are established.
implementation: Explicit managed ingress captures actual Core source audience/controller/credential incarnation before source observation acceptance, without changing capabilities/media or retaining original invocation/readers. NativeDtmfObservation carries an opaque scene-issued disclosure.

Fresh route-policy acquisition binds the actual native recipient identity/Device/Endpoint/Participant epoch/principal/credential revision and attaches a scene-only audience fence to its exact DtmfWriteLease. Core route plus sealed physical source/recipient fences remain mandatory.

Audience IO tries only member/audience registries, preserves immutable original groups and checks current groups. It never reenters held controller/credential/lifecycle locks or domain policy and releases guards on Pending. Another Connection of the same Participant stays outside the original private group.

Same-managed-Session native recipients are supported by this helper. Unmanaged/general and SIP/WebRTC host audience compositions remain separate explicit responsibilities; managed refusal never silently selects a different ingress path.
